construction.null: circular date-shift of the firing mask, 400 shifts, |shift| >= 63 sessions
construction.screen: BH-FDR q=0.10 over the family (canon section 63)
construction.horizon: each candidate's own move horizon (20 or 60 sessions), gross of costs

read_me_first: The ORIGIN read is in-sample by construction (the rule was written while looking at a move on that security); only the FOREIGN read can promote anything, and even that is a SCREEN, not a claim. Survivors go to the registered admission path, never straight to a book.

family_read.verdict: ONE FAMILY, NOT 391 FINDINGS. Every foreign-read excess sits in the TOP tail: rules of the shape 'drawdown_pct <= -X and vix >= Y (and vol_ratio_20_60 > 1)' -> long 20/60 sessions, i.e. rebound after a stressed drawdown. The bottom tail is at chance (5.5% vs 5%). The rules share VIX, which is the same series for all six securities, so the 391 are one mechanism read 391 times (feedback: check whether the noise is shared). BH-FDR is under-resolved here: a 400-shift null cannot produce p below 0.0025, so zero survivors is the null's granularity, not a verdict.
family_read.next_test: Register ONE rule family, not 3,050 rules: drawdown/VIX/vol-ratio thresholds chosen on SPY/XLF/XLE pre-2016 (the mining slice), scored on the held six, net of 25 bps a side, against a 4,000-shift null and a random-threshold twin; compare with whatever the research gym's market_stress book already reads before calling it new.
